body: As I approach the bakery, the air is thick with the scent of freshly baked bread and cakes, mingling with an unsettling chill from the cool evening. My heart races at the thought of potential danger or harm from those still operating under the influence of last night’s celebration. I take a deep breath, steeling myself for whatever might come my way.
